rows.en: Even so… Granzairus… he's a terrifying foe!
Even so… Granzairus… he's a terrifying foe!
Nngh… What are you doing? Letting them slip away so easily!!
Nngh… Why? You had them cornered that far, so why not finish them off in one blow?

Hah hah hah hah… There is nothing to fear!

RX, the three Riders and their comrades… Granzairus will surely destroy them all!!
And if… Granzairus is defeated, what then? Dasmader!!
If RX defeats Granzairus, a city or two will be reduced to ruins!
What!?
I believe I said Granzairus is a weapon of destruction! His body is a megaton-class bomb in itself.
As expected of His Majesty's weapon of destruction… With this, they won't be able to lift a finger! This is the end of RX.

I do not think so…

RX is a fearsome opponent! In the end, he will defeat Granzairus even if it costs him his own life…
Dasmader, what do you mean?

His Majesty the Emperor sees into RX's heart completely!

The instant RX makes his final move… RX will be blown to pieces together with Granzairus!

That is the very moment of glory His Majesty has been waiting for!!

Whew… What an ordeal that was!

That woman Maribaron or whatever got me good with her sorcery… My head's still pounding.
Everyone… I'm truly sorry for making you all worry.
Getting captured by the enemy… Geez, that's not like you.

I know…

I was planning to use that Kaima Robot being attacked by its comrades to investigate the enemy's headquarters, but…
So you let your guard down, huh?

I'm sorry…

But the Crisis Empire's Earth Attack Corps is using the Crisis Fortress, with Naager's help, to travel freely between here and the Kaima World.

It seems Granzairus was sent here directly from the Kaima World too.
The Kaima World…
Sorry, everyone… That was super dicey for me too! But seriously, thanks for saving me, for real…
Geez… you're ten years too early for going solo!
Easy for you to say… In ten years, I'll be… an old lady…
What are you talking about? That's not what I meant…
Well, whatever, right? Everyone's safe and sound like this… okay?
Y-You're the last person who gets to say that!! Geez, what kind of person are you!
The [HERO4] kind~…
"Still… I'm glad… really glad you're safe…"
Still, he was a tough one… If next time…!?
Granzairus is burning down the city!
That thing's a monster! The TDF sent out its security units too, but they can't even scratch it!!
I'll go!
Wait, Kotaro… Can you beat him the way you are now?
Our attacks don't work on him! Why don't we take our time and work out a plan?

There's no time for that!

This city… is where people live their lives, a place they spent a long time building!

Everyone here has lived sharing their joys and sorrows in this city! I won't let that thing destroy it!
Kotaro…
Kotaro!!
Kotaro!!
I don't care what happens to my life!
Everyone, we're going too!!
Right!!
To defeat the fearsome enemy Granzairus, Kotaro rose up. It was truly… a challenge with his life on the line.
But… a terrible trap had been set inside Granzairus's body.
RX, come out!! Come out and fight me!
Granzairus!!
So you came, Kotaro… Think you can beat me?
Hold it! We're here too!
I won't let you do as you please any longer! Hen… shin!!
I am the child of the sun! Kamen Rider BLACK RX!! Strongest monster Granzairus, I challenge you!
Kuh… At this rate, he'll finish us!
What do I do? What do I…
He really is strong… But I can't afford to lose!!
Ugh… Am I going to die here?
Kuh… RX's attacks don't work?
Kuh… Can't Robo Rider beat him either!?
Whoa…!!
Kotaro!! Get away while you can! We'll take care of the rest!!

No… I can't run!

If I run… Granzairus will chase after me and destroy one city after another!

So many people will lose their lives. …I'm going to fight!!
But… how are you going to fight in that state?
Kotaro…
Bio Riderrr!!
Ichijouji!! I'm going inside his body to blow him up!
B-Bio Rider!? Stop!! If you do that, you'll be killed!

…………

Even so… I have to do it!

Granzairus! I swear I'll defeat you!!
Silence, Bio Rider! I've seen through all your abilities! They won't work on me!
Gwah!? Gwoooooh!! What is this!?
Granzairus! I'll destroy your electronic mechanisms!

Bio Rider!? Since when?

Stooop!! If I explode, you'll be blown to pieces too!!
I've left my life in heaven's hands!
Gwaaaaaah!!
Kotarooo!!
Heh heh heh… Hah hah hah hah!!

Our nemesis… Kamen Rider BLACK RX has perished!

General Jark, I want you to build an airport on the ruins, and quickly.

Wait!

RX has perished… but those who are every bit his equal still live! Defeating them comes first!
General Jark… please leave them to me!
Failure will not be tolerated… Maribaron!!

I too am the commander of the Kaima Monster Clan Battalion… I shall use every sorcery I have to destroy them!!

Kaima Robots who dwell in the demon realm of space… Bio-Beasts, Demon Beasts, Fushigi Beasts!

I shall revive you all, and now let you take revenge on those who struck you down!
Come forth, Kaima Robots!!
Come forth, Bio-Beasts!!

uncertain: U13545: speaker 'His Majesty's Inspector' is Dasmader (named in U13546).
U13556-U13568: two variants of the reunion (formal / casual heroine). U13566-U13567 pun on なんて奴だ ('what kind of person') -> 'The [HERO4] kind~'.
U13570: narration row with no speaker; reads as a report (Taki or Kotaro). Translated neutrally.
U13571: 警備班 here is the TDF's security units.
U13589: 最強怪人 rendered 'Strongest monster' (怪人 = Monster per glossary convention).
U13618/U13620: 異星獣 read as 異生獣 (Kaima Bio-Beasts); 魔怪獣 rendered 'Demon Beasts', 不思議獣 'Fushigi Beasts' (glossary uses 'Fushigi Beast Baribari'). 宇宙霍界 read as 宇宙魔界 ('demon realm of space').

new_names.why: Sharivan monster class, not in glossary
class name, following 不思議獣バリバリ
